# How much of your business loss is deductible this year?

> Free calculator for the IRC 461(l) excess business loss limitation, now permanent under OBBBA — computes how much of a pass-through owner's net business loss is deductible this year against the 2025/2026 threshold, and how much becomes a net operating loss carryforward. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
